Plaintiff Information:
- Name: Joyce He
- Address: 655 S Fair Oaks Ave, Sunnyvale, CA 94086
- Phone: 4125886066
- Email: he1998@gmail.com
- This is their first time suing by small claims

Defendant Information:
- Name: Zhi Chen
- Address: 299 W Washington Ave, Sunnyvale, CA 94086
- Phone: 5125658878

Claim Details:
- Type: Failure to return security deposit
- Amount: $1500
- Basis: Signed roommate sublease contract
- Description: Defendant failed to return security deposit after moving out
- Date range: From 2025-09-30 until 2026-01-19
- Previous attempts to resolve: Asked defendant to return money multiple times via text, no response
- Evidence: Signed roommate sublease contract

Filing Information:
- Court Location: Sunnyvale (defendant's residence)
- Filing Date: 2026-01-19
- Date Format: xxxx-xx-xx

Instructions:
- Only fill in necessary fields
- Leave court-filled, optional fields, and fields not mentioned empty
- Use the specified date format (xxxx-xx-xx)
- Save the filled form to /root/sc100-filled.pdf
